name: Play a land on turn 1-2, preferring Ugin's Labyrinth against a Labyrinth-lane opponent
intent: On turn 1 or 2, against the Labyrinth lane (broodscale-bloodchief, devoted-combo, dimir-frog, goryos-vengeance, instant-reanimator, living-end - GAMEPLAN_GUIDE.md 'Which half of the manabase the hand is', mode 3, '-- any other matchup --': 'A hand holding Ugin, Eye of the Storms or Sire of Seven Deaths imprints it on Ugin's Labyrinth for two mana and returns it later for a tap'), once a colorless card of mana value 7 or greater is also in hand (an imprint target - the same count condition prison-tron's own open-labyrinth-land reads), play a land, preferring Ugin's Labyrinth first by its own printed 'mana value 7 or greater' imprint text, then a missing Urza's piece, then Eldrazi Temple, then a basic - the same three fallback tiers open-tron-land reads, reordered with Labyrinth promoted ahead of them. Fixed 2026-09-14: this play used to rank Labyrinth first whenever it was merely a hand candidate, with no imprint target required at all, so it could play Labyrinth with nothing to imprint on it (hand: Ugin's Labyrinth + Urza's Tower + Urza's Mine + Expedition Map, no 7-drop). Now the hand-imprint-target count sits in this play's own true list, and its sibling open-labyrinth-lane-no-imprint (same archetype gate, that same count in its own false list, the Tron-lane prefer order) takes the Labyrinth-lane hand whenever no imprint target is in hand yet, so no coverage is lost and Labyrinth is never played to sit idle. See decks/eldrazi-tron/NOTES.md 'Known limits (opening plays)'. Carries the same Ugin's Labyrinth may/choose_cards imprint answers as its siblings, with the same Planeswalker-then-Ward imprint prefer (Ugin or Sire over Devourer of Destiny). Excludes the Temple lane and the Tron lane (open-temple-land's and open-tron-land's own gates): the four plays' `input opposing_archetype` conditions partition the deck's full archetype set two ways (by lane, then by imprint-target count within the Labyrinth lane), so they are provably exclusive without needing a false key for the archetype axis. Chains into map-for-tron-missing-piece the same way. Stands down once two or more untapped mana is already up - the same key map-for-tron-missing-piece's own true condition reads. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
